about.ledePrefix: Six years at a SaaS startup taught me that

about.p1: I'm an AI Integration Engineer based in Lisbon with an unusual combination: a continuous six-year journey at ChatGuru, growing from first Customer Success hire to Director, plus IntegraNinja, a part-time integration consultancy I founded and ran alongside it, delivering automation for clients in legal, retail, healthcare, and real estate.
about.p2: My work sits where LLMs meet real business systems: API integrations, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and the operational backbones I spent years optimizing by hand. Currently studying AI & Machine Learning Engineering, focused on building scalable, useful systems.

roles.desc: Led company strategy across product, operations, and engineering. Owned the AI chatbot roadmap: conversation flows, prompt strategies, and integration architecture with third-party platforms in production.

Independent integration consultancy run in parallel with my role at ChatGuru. Architected automation and integration solutions with n8n, Make, Python, and REST APIs for 15+ clients across legal, retail, healthcare, real estate, and professional services, cutting manual effort by 60%.
Led cross-functional teams of 15+ people. Designed API integration workflows for client onboarding automation, cutting time-to-value by 40%. Drove automation that reduced manual work by 60%.
Built and managed the Customer Success team. Established processes for onboarding, retention, and expansion.
First CS hire. Handled customer onboarding, support, and success workflows from the ground up.

cases.title: Semantic search over support tickets
cases.problem: An IT services client had years of resolutions locked inside Freshservice tickets. Agents kept solving the same issues from scratch.
cases.architecture: RAG pipeline with Freshservice, Supabase pgvector, and n8n sync workflows. Embeddings on ticket resolutions, retrieval wired into the agent workflow.
cases.result: Past resolutions surfaced instantly during triage, as part of an automation program that cut manual effort by 60%.

cases.title: AI on the WhatsApp API: JIPPfy
cases.problem: Small businesses answering the same WhatsApp questions by hand, all day, every day.
cases.architecture: Next.js product on the WhatsApp API with LLM-driven agent workflows (GPT and Claude APIs) handling first-line conversations.
cases.result: Automated first-line replies in production. Live at jippfy.pt.

cases.title: CRM / ERP integration delivery
cases.problem: Client data siloed across HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, SAP, and custom APIs, with teams re-typing data between systems.
cases.architecture: n8n and Make workflows, REST APIs and webhooks, plus Python microservices, owning the full lifecycle from requirements to delivery.
cases.result: 15+ client projects delivered across legal, retail, healthcare, real estate, and professional services, cutting manual work by 60%.
